material_difference: The first tilted-square trial compared opposite parallel classes; the second existing-grid trial compared axis directions. This new design compares the actual side vs diagonal roles of different point pairs: squared lengths 8 vs16. All blue boundary sides belong to one class; both red internal diagonals to the other. The predicted side/diagonal role-mixing error is different from orientation restriction or universal equal-sidedness. This is not a relabel of either failed test and does not reuse its PNG.
preset_source: The new 8-vs16 metric role comparison, frozen before this candidate is tested.
